metadata.description: Region for all regional resources.
Lowercase letters and digits only; prefixes resource names.
Organization label stamped on every record by the collector. Client-supplied values are overwritten.
Application (client) ID of the Entra ID app registration that represents the ingestion API.
Tenant that issues ingestion tokens.
Set to false for the first deployment, push the image, then redeploy with true.
Collector image as repository:tag in the registry this template creates.
Set to true after pushing the insights image and registering its Entra applications (docs/production-access.md).
Insights portal image as repository:tag in the registry this template creates.
Organization name shown in the insights portal.
Tenant of the insights API and portal registrations.
Application (client) ID of the insights API registration that defines Insights.Admin and Insights.Publisher.
Application (client) ID of the insights portal single-page application registration.
Optional private DNS hostname for the collector. Supply a matching PFX and password when set.
Base64-encoded PFX for collectorHostname. Supply through a private parameter file, never source control.
Password of the PFX supplied in tlsCertificateData.
Address space of the dedicated virtual network.
Container Apps infrastructure subnet; /27 or larger.
Subnet for private endpoints.
Peered client networks (for example, the Dev Box network) that must resolve the collector endpoint.
Client CIDR ranges allowed to call the collector. Empty allows any address in connected networks.
Temporary public IP ranges allowed to push images. Empty keeps the registry private-only.
Whether Log Analytics and Application Insights accept queries from public networks.
Retention for collected usage telemetry, in days.

resources.name: [variables('collectorAppName')]
dependsOn: [extensionResourceId(resourceId('Microsoft.Insights/components', format('{0}-appi', variables('prefix'))), 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments', guid(resourceId('Microsoft.Insights/components', format('{0}-appi', variables('prefix'))), resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-collector-id', variables('prefix'))), variables('monitoringMetricsPublisherRoleId')))]

resources.name: [variables('insightsAppName')]
dependsOn: [extensionResourceId(resourceId('Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces', format('{0}-usage-law', variables('prefix'))), 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments', guid(resourceId('Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces', format('{0}-usage-law', variables('prefix'))), resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-insights-id', variables('prefix'))), variables('logAnalyticsReaderRoleId')))]

collectorEndpoint.value: [if(empty(parameters('collectorHostname')), format('https://{0}.{1}', variables('collectorAppName'), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.App/managedEnvironments', format('{0}-aca-env', variables('prefix'))), '2024-03-01').defaultDomain), format('https://{0}', parameters('collectorHostname')))]
